exposure: High blood pressure at entry into antenatal care
cohort: 1116 pregnant women, with a median gestational age of 20 weeks, 53% of whom were living with HIV
finding: In this cohort of pregnant women, high blood pressure at entry into antenatal care was not associated with an increased risk of adverse birth outcomes, except for large-for-gestational age.
mod_finding: High blood pressure at entry into antenatal care did not significantly increase the risk of cesarean delivery.
